notes.title: Amazing Grace -What color is your attribute?-
notes.notes:
We hope you are enjoying your stay in NUKITASHI.
As many of you might have already read our announcement from X(Twitter), the store page for our upcoming visual novel, Amazing Grace -What color is your attribute?-, is now open!

Here's a short description of the game:
“A holy night with no dawn, my dear...” You awaken in a strange town full of art, blanketed in snow, and enclosed by a massive wall. On Christmas, it all burns down—and the girl who loves it most rewinds time to the start of Advent. Find the truth in the loop and paint it on this canvas of a town!

It's packed with adorable characters, and its original release in Japan was loved by many visual novel fans, just like NUKITASHI! It's not as chaotic(in a good way ofc!) as NUKITASHI, but it has a rich story and is full of mysteries for you to unravel.

You can wishlist the game here to get notified on release day. ➡
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2553910/_What_color_is_your_attribute/?curator_clanid=35756289

It's the first Cabbage Soft VN that we localize, but we believe that it won't be our last!
We'll be posting updates of NUKITASHI2 and Cabbage Soft VN on our X(Twitter), so don't forget to follow here:
https://twitter.com/shiravune

Thank you for your support!
